reference_region.meaning: Economy whose national accounts are reported; includes its external accounts.

origin_region.meaning: Origin of the imported product; never implies a complete endogenous national ledger.

destination_region.meaning: Destination of exports when supplied by the source.

partner_region.meaning: Counterparty country for a specifically observed transaction.

imported_commodity.meaning: Descriptor of imported products, distinct from the using Activity or destination-market Commodity.

pending.denominator: Da definire per il blocco e la chiusura economica; nessuna normalizzazione automatica.

account_total.denominator: Full authoritative expenditure of the column account; inactive zero accounts have zero coefficients, active signed zero totals are undefined.

pending.rule: Review item types, valuation and import representation before defining a SUT projection.

derived_only.rule: Do not add a balance or presentation view to native flow totals.
